top_categories.workout_context: 61ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Opelika Okey Dokey, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
At mile 60 of 104, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Opelika Okey Dokey. Train it until it feels boring.
Opelika Okey Dokey's Rolling gravel, Rural Alabama forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 104 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Opelika Okey Dokey's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
6,384ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
6,384ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 104 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
104 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 104 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,384ft of climbing on Alabama rolling gravel does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Opelika Okey Dokey’s 104 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Opelika Okey Dokey requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on alabama rolling gravel to build confidence. Expect: rolling gravel, rural alabama, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Durability to prepare you for 104 miles of alabama rolling gravel in Opelika, Alabama.
